Statement 1 claims that scientists have compared "images of M87*" from multiple years. However, this contradicts the fundamental physics of black holes. Scientists can detect and analyze electromagnetic radiation from the accretion disk and jets around black holes, as well as study how this radiation is polarized as it interacts with magnetic fields in the vicinity.

The key difference is that Statement 2 acknowledges that no actual images have been obtained, while Statement 1 incorrectly suggests direct imaging is possible.
